en.headline: Government to hold ceremony for Sun Yat-sen's 160th birth anniversary
en.dek: An official event will take place on 12 November at Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park, with special stamps and community activities also planned.
body: The government announced on Friday that an official ceremony will be held on 12 November to mark the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen.

November 12, 2026, marks 160 years since the birth of the figure described by the government as a great national hero, patriot and forerunner of China's democratic revolution. The ceremony will take place in the morning at Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park.

Hongkong Post will issue special stamps on the same day. Various government departments and community organisations will organise exhibitions, seminars, guided tours, film screenings and other activities starting this month to mark the anniversary.

zh.headline: 政府將於11月12日舉行孫中山誕辰160周年紀念儀式
zh.dek: 官方儀式在孫中山紀念公園舉行，郵政局同日發行特別郵票，並有一系列社區活動。
body: 政府周五宣布，將於11月12日舉行官方儀式，紀念孫中山先生誕辰160周年。
2026年11月12日是孫中山先生誕辰160周年。政府形容他為偉大的民族英雄、偉大的愛國者及中國民主革命的偉大先行者。儀式將於上午在孫中山紀念公園舉行。
香港郵政局將同日發行特別郵票。政府部門及社區組織由本月起舉辦展覽、研討會、導賞團、電影放映等活動，讓市民從不同角度了解孫中山的生平及貢獻。
